units.source_text: 的确，在遥远的过去，我似乎曾在某个地方看见过无比壮丽的晚霞，

en.t: Indeed, in the distant past, I seem once to have seen an incomparably magnificent sunset somewhere,

units.source_text: 此后我总觉得我所看到的晚霞或多或少已经褪了色，

en.t: and ever since then I have always felt that the sunsets I saw had more or less lost their color,
Could this really be my sin?
